front: This is Stamp’s post office. Your mailbox is here, with letters to read, replies to write, and sorting work from Stamp.
title: Your Mailbox
empty: No letters in your mailbox. Its corners are very orderly.
noaddress: Post goes to a house with a sign name. Your homestead fence has no name on it yet.
shut: The post counter is closed. The scale is having a quiet moment.
reported: The letter has left your mailbox. It will be read.
nopass: The counter cannot find your house name yet. Your letter waits in the writing tray.
refused: This letter stays in the writing tray.

round.on: A tray of post is on the counter, with the pigeonholes open behind it.
round.off: The tray is put away. The counter is clear again.
round.far: The counter is just there, waiting.
round.hint: Each card belongs in the hole with its matching stamp.

receipt.title: Sorting Receipt
receipt.take: {n} of {of} cards went straight to their holes.
receipt.counted: Stamp has this round on the week’s sheet.
receipt.short: This round is not on the sheet. The counter will be ready again.

card.title: Picture Postcard
lines: This made me think of you.
The view is doing most of the work.
I picked this spot on purpose.
Standing here seemed like a plan.
The stamp has been given a job.
card.sent: The postcard joins the outgoing mail.

folk.title: Neighbours’ Houses
folk.empty: Nobody is about just now. The book rests open.
folk.none: That name or house name is not in the book.
